response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering fundamentals, excellent communication skills, and proven ability to work with complex systems, he lacks the core technical requirements for this role. He has minimal Java experience (last work ~2018, over 6 years ago), no demonstrated Kotlin expertise, no Spring ecosystem experience, and no background in IDE development or language tooling. His recent career trajectory has shifted away from JVM technologies toward TypeScript/web development, making him poorly positioned for a senior role requiring deep, current Java/JVM and enterprise framework expertise.
strengths: Strong software architecture and design fundamentals with demonstrated commitment to TDD, clean code, and extensible systems across complex domains
Excellent communication and teaching abilities evidenced by multiple workshops, conference talks, and open-source contributions to developer tooling
Proven track record building large-scale systems including high-throughput microservices handling millions of requests per second with focus on performance and reliability
concerns: Minimal Java experience (last work ~2018) with no demonstrated expertise in Kotlin, despite both being core requirements for the role
Complete absence of Spring ecosystem or enterprise framework experience, which is a required qualification for this position
No background in IDE development or language tooling; only tangential IDE experience from 2014-2015 with a C IDE, not JVM-related work

key_factors.factor: Missing Spring and enterprise framework experience
Strong software engineering fundamentals and architecture skills
